headline: Sensex and Nifty rally amid strong foreign institutional inflows and robust corporate earnings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surge in foreign institutional investor (FII/FPI) inflows driving benchmark indices higher.
Strong Q2 corporate earnings performance leading charge in large-cap stocks.
Gains led primarily by financial and auto sector stocks.
Supportive cues from advancing Asian markets.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,300 points while Nifty traded near 25,200 to 25,375 levels.
BEML planned building tunnel-boring machines to lower reliance on imports from China.
Tata Power reported Q2 results with brokerages remaining bullish despite target price cuts.
Adani Group signed a copper exploration project agreement with Codelco.
summary: Indian benchmark indices rose sharply driven by foreign capital inflows and strong corporate earnings performance. Auto and financial stocks led the broad market rally pushing Nifty towards key resistance levels. Key individual movers included BEML, Tata Power, Paytm, and Adani Group stocks following major announcements and brokerage recommendations.
